evidence.message: Units table has spike_times but resolution is not set. Resolution indicates the smallest possible difference between two spike times and should be a positive float equal to 1/sampling_rate of the recording system (e.g., Units(resolution=1/30000) for a 30 kHz system). This information is needed to assess the precision of spike timing data.
Unit 0 contains descending spike times, which is always a data error. Spike times should be sorted in strictly ascending order.
